# PhysioNIRS

`PhysioNIRS` provides governed SNIRF input/output, optical-density,
haemoglobin, motion-correction, and short-separation contracts for
near-infrared spectroscopy data represented as `PhysioExperiment`
objects.

``` r

library(PhysioNIRS)

x <- readSNIRF("recording.snirf")
measurementList(x)
sourceDetectorDistances(x, unit = "m")
writeSNIRF(x, "roundtrip.snirf")
```

For a governed optical-density assay, short-separation processing is
explicit:

``` r

x_od <- intensityToOD(x, assay_name = "raw")
short <- identifyShortChannels(x_od, threshold_m = 0.01)
corrected <- shortSeparationRegress(
  x_od, assay_name = "OD", short = short
)
nuisance <- shortSeparationDesign(
  x_od,
  assay_name = "OD",
  short = short,
  aggregation = "mean",
  physiology_bands = c("mayer", "respiration")
)
```

Short-channel regression is a signal-processing choice, not evidence
that a channel contains only extracerebral physiology. Named physiology
bands are nuisance ranges rather than diagnoses, and
population-appropriate explicit ranges should be used when the adult
defaults are unsuitable.

SNIRF metadata can contain subject identifiers and acquisition dates.
Remove or replace identifying metadata before sharing files.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`PhysioNIRS`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/PhysioNIRS-package.md)
  [`PhysioNIRS-package`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/PhysioNIRS-package.md)
  : PhysioNIRS: governed NIRS data and SNIRF input/output
- [`dpf()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/dpf.md) :
  Estimate a differential pathlength factor
- [`extinctionCoefficients()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/extinctionCoefficients.md)
  : Get governed haemoglobin extinction coefficients
- [`identifyShortChannels()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/identifyShortChannels.md)
  : Identify short source-detector channels
- [`intensityToOD()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/intensityToOD.md)
  : Convert continuous-wave fNIRS intensity to optical density
- [`mbll()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/mbll.md)
  : Convert optical density to haemoglobin concentration change
- [`measurementList()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/measurementList.md)
  : Return the governed SNIRF measurement list
- [`motionArtifactDetect()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/motionArtifactDetect.md)
  : Detect fNIRS motion artifacts by channel
- [`nirsNeurofeedbackStart()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/nirsNeurofeedback-lifecycle.md)
  [`nirsNeurofeedbackStep()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/nirsNeurofeedback-lifecycle.md)
  [`nirsNeurofeedbackState()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/nirsNeurofeedback-lifecycle.md)
  [`nirsNeurofeedbackStop()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/nirsNeurofeedback-lifecycle.md)
  [`nirsNeurofeedbackScope()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/nirsNeurofeedback-lifecycle.md)
  : Control and inspect live NIRS neurofeedback
- [`nirsNeurofeedback()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/nirsNeurofeedback.md)
  : Construct a governed live fNIRS neurofeedback controller
- [`physiologyBandpass()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/physiologyBandpass.md)
  : Extract an explicit fNIRS physiology frequency band
- [`print(`*`<NIRSNeurofeedback>`*`)`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/print.NIRSNeurofeedback.md)
  : Display a governed NIRS neurofeedback runtime
- [`print(`*`<nirs_quality>`*`)`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/print.nirs_quality.md)
  : Display a governed NIRS quality result
- [`pruneChannels()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/pruneChannels.md)
  : Mark or drop channels using governed NIRS quality results
- [`readSNIRF()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/readSNIRF.md)
  : Read a Shared Near Infrared Spectroscopy Format file
- [`scalpCouplingIndex()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/scalpCouplingIndex.md)
  : Calculate the governed fNIRS scalp-coupling index
- [`shortSeparationDesign()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/shortSeparationDesign.md)
  : Construct a governed short-separation nuisance design
- [`shortSeparationRegress()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/shortSeparationRegress.md)
  : Regress governed short-separation nuisance signals
- [`signalQualityIndex()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/signalQualityIndex.md)
  : Calculate governed fNIRS signal quality
- [`sourceDetectorDistances()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/sourceDetectorDistances.md)
  : Calculate source-detector distances for each SNIRF measurement
- [`splineMotionCorrect()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/splineMotionCorrect.md)
  : Correct detected fNIRS motion intervals with cubic smoothing splines
- [`tddr()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/tddr.md)
  : Repair fNIRS motion artifacts with TDDR
- [`waveletMotionCorrect()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/waveletMotionCorrect.md)
  : Correct fNIRS motion with a shift-invariant db2 wavelet transform
- [`writeSNIRF()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNIRS/reference/writeSNIRF.md)
  : Write a Shared Near Infrared Spectroscopy Format file
